correctness.rationale: Conjugation averaging over S_n is norm nonincreasing and preserves extension property, reducing global linear-operator infimum to the one-parameter symmetric midpoint row with 2a+(n-2)b=1 and t=a-b. For every target point pair, its Lipschitz norm equals half the l1 norm of the zero-sum coefficient difference divided by Euclidean distance: the equilateral vertex Lip unit ball is the range<=1 polytope. Derived complete five orbit types: vertex pairs 1, vertex-incident I, vertex-nonincident N, touching midpoints 2|t|, disjoint midpoints 2sqrt2|t| (last absent n=3). For n>=4 the universal lower affine envelopes I>=2(n-1-(n-2)t)/n and D>=2sqrt2*t meet at t=(n-1)/(n sqrt2+n-2), where all other contributions obey the bound and a,b>0. For n=3 envelopes I>=(4-2t)/3 and N>=(4+4t)/(3sqrt3) meet at t=6sqrt3-10. Independent numerical orbit evaluation for all n=3..80 corroborated; global optimality is analytical and applies to unsymmetrized operators through averaging.
